mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases recession risk and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index exceeds 215 and the federal funds rate is at least 2.0%, it indicates persistent inflation without monetary accommodation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 950 thousand units), strong retail sales (RSAFS > 378,000 million dollars) indicate resilient consumer spending, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the regime condition, or the correlation between the condition and returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls level above 137,000 thousand persons indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 137000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 (index, 2017=100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which depresses corporate earnings and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary demand environment (GDPC1 < 11700 billion dollars), a rebound in quarterly GDP above 11690 billion dollars signals economic recovery, which supports equity returns and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the regime condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) and a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates a recessionary environment with aggressive monetary easing, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression over any 2-year window.
